[[File:Hoistcable.png|thumb|214px|Luke Skywalker using a hoist cable fired from a magnetic gun]]
'''Hoist cables''' were a strong cord wound to a cable drum that could be worn on a belt. They were used in moving heavy cargo or in climbing expeditions. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was wearing one during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], and used it to ascend into the belly of an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] in order to set a detonator inside.
